command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; printf 'user='; whoami; printf 'host='; hostname; printf 'time='; date -Iseconds; echo '===OMEGA_CLONES==='; while IFS= read -r gd; do d=${gd%/.git}; r=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$r" in *oMEGAcV1*|*crush*|*Crush*) echo "REPO=$d"; echo "REMOTE=$r"; echo "HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"; echo "BRANCH=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true)"; git -C "$d" status --short --branch || true; [ -f "$d/scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh" ] && { stat -c 'HARNESS_MODE=%a HARNESS=%n' "$d/scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh"; sha256sum "$d/scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh"; }; esac; done < <(find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 5 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | sort); echo '===CRUSH_PROCESSES==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,cmd --sort=pid | grep -Ei '[c]rush|oMEGAcV1' || true; echo '===CRUSH_USER_UNITS==='; systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'crush|omega' || true; systemctl --user list-units --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'crush|omega' || true
